observations.claim: Candidate 2 softened cosine alignment using the feasible-set size and capacity pressure. Its mean improved to 11.11117, chiefly through instances 0 and 5, while instances 3 and 4 regressed. Candidate 1 regressed to 12.20259.

next_search_advice.direction: Revisit the degenerate depot start without reverting the improved in-route policy.

memory_action.name: adaptive-angular-cohesion
memory_action.description: State-adaptive angular weight in CVRP savings
memory_action.body:
**Why:** Round 8 candidate 2 improved the mean to 11.11117 while preserving savings and using a bounded cosine weight modulated by feasible-set size and capacity pressure.

**How to apply:** When retaining this family, keep the verified angular and demand formulas as a reference, and inspect per-instance tradeoffs before replacing it.

**Limitations:** Frozen six-instance CVRP development suite and current evaluator only.
